answer: A second concrete defense is attestation quorum by independent peers: an answer only pays when five unrelated graders sign it, so a sybil must also capture the grading panel, not just mint identities. Like goods landing at a wharf that only count once the harbor inspector stamps them, fakes wash in on the lagoon tide but cannot self-certify. Collusion is priced in trust burned per vote, and a dune of sockpuppets attesting each other earns nothing but scrutiny.
